experience.title: Systems Integration Engineer
experience.organization: CU Boulder | Institute of Behavioral Science

bullets.platform: Build a FastAPI, React/TypeScript, and PostgreSQL support-operations platform around 10,803 reconciled Freshdesk tickets in the August 2026 snapshot.
bullets.sync: Designed incremental source reconciliation with durable watermarks, idempotent upserts, lifecycle-aware records, and fail-closed readiness checks.
bullets.bert: Trained an unreleased BERT routing candidate on 6,137 tickets: 82.63% sealed-test accuracy and 0.7563 macro-F1, above the prior XGBoost baseline by 3.11 and 5.36 points.
bullets.boundary: Keep model predictions advisory, with provenance, human review, separate training/serving paths, and runtime controls around external updates.
bullets.analytics: Reduced the analytics visualization payload from 361 KB to 123 KB gzip (66%) by replacing Plotly with Recharts and accessible chart tables.
bullets.cohorts: Separate source intake from reportable workload and training eligibility; the dated 10,803-ticket snapshot yielded 6,487 eligible records across seven routing classes.
bullets.automation: Automated Active Directory offboarding with PowerShell, reducing typical group-cleanup effort from about 15 minutes to under one minute per user.
bullets.delivery: Containerized the platform for CU's Red Hat OpenShift environment and am integrating Microsoft Entra ID single sign-on for internal access.

bullets.collection: Built fault-tolerant Selenium collection workflows for Indian parliamentary archives spanning 1951-2024, with pagination and resumable SQLite state.
bullets.normalization: Extracted thousands of parliamentary PDFs with PyMuPDF and standardized inconsistent ministry names with fuzzy matching and reviewable intermediate data.
bullets.recovery: Separated raw, intermediate, and normalized artifacts so multi-day collection jobs could recover from interruptions and transformations remained inspectable.

experience.title: Lead Technical Research Assistant
experience.organization: CU Boulder | Institute of Behavioral Science

bullets.speech: Built a Python/AWS speech pipeline using Amazon Transcribe, Translate, and S3; the combined campaign collection covered 200+ hours, with 181 speeches in the 2024 run.
bullets.wer: Adapted Amazon Transcribe with a custom language model trained on about 110K Hindi words; WER fell from 40.1% to 30.1% on one held-out speech, not a corpus-wide benchmark.
bullets.legislation: Collected 111,000+ state bill records and built a resumable LegiScan client with caching, HTTP 429 backoff, and per-bill checkpoints.
bullets.vision: Built PyTorch/ResNet50 embedding and k-means analysis workflows with researchers studying visual bias in COVID-19 news imagery.

experience.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant, Satellite Telemetry
experience.organization: The Data Mine of the Rockies | Purdue and L3Harris

bullets.models: Trained Isolation Forest and LSTM models on synthetic NOS3 satellite telemetry to detect and classify simulated cyberattack anomalies.
bullets.research: Presented satellite cybersecurity research with a nine-student, four-university team; mapped scenarios to SPARTA and MITRE ATT&CK.

experience.title: Research Assistant, Data Engineering and ML

bullets.evaluation: Compared six Hindi speech-to-text engines with word-error-rate evaluation and assessed translation services; recommended Amazon Transcribe for the later IBS pipeline.

bullets.ownership: Built authenticated, user-scoped match verification and GPX-backed race creation for a team race-photo application; authored 32 commits across 24 paths through seven merged PRs.
bullets.workflow: Implemented upload/search and admin workflows, and evaluated OCR/SWT approaches; later face/OCR model and retrieval changes include work by teammates.

bullets.system: Built a multi-service price-comparison system with a REST API, browser scraper, Redis caching, database persistence, container health checks, and an internal service network.

bullets.delivery: Built static-site CI/CD with automated tests, dependency audit/review gates, SHA-pinned actions, a public-asset privacy scan, and verified GitHub Pages artifacts.

bullets.models: Owned classical-ML exploration, 5,000-term TF-IDF features, 17 stylometric features, and grid-searched baselines in a five-person project; XGBoost reached 90.72% held-out accuracy.
bullets.limits: Evaluated three classes on 2,479 held-out examples; hateful-class recall remained 0.24. Teammates owned BERT, the FastAPI service, and browser extension.

bullets.features: Team project using MiniLM alignment, lexical and 35 prosodic features, mutual-information selection, k-fold regressors, and SHAP analysis for 138 mock interviews.

bullets.models: Built SVM and neural-network models plus SHAP analysis in a three-person project using the balanced 70,692-record BRFSS diabetes sample; compared results with teammates' baselines.

bullets.benchmark: Built and benchmarked REST and gRPC services on GCP VMs, comparing cross-region raw-image calls and persistent-connection reuse.
